original_ai_output.title_zh: 被几内亚驱逐的金矿工人开始离开马里集结地
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 数百名被几内亚驱逐的金矿工人开始离开他们在马里的集结地，该地点本身也是一处金矿。当地动用卡车和巴士运送这些矿工。据马里方面11月7日宣布，自几内亚开展打击非法采矿行动以来，马里已接收约16万名被驱逐人员。

location.raw_text: a location in Mali where they gathered after being expelled by neighboring Guinea

key_facts.fact: 数百名被几内亚驱逐的金矿工人开始离开马里的集结地
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Hundreds of gold miners have started departing a location in Mali where they gathered after being expelled by neighboring Guinea.

key_facts.fact: 当地动用卡车和巴士运送这些矿工
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Trucks and buses are being used to transport the miners.

key_facts.fact: 马里11月7日宣布已接收约16万名自几内亚被驱逐人员
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: On November 7, Bamako announced that it had taken in around 160,000 people expelled from Guinea since the start of operations against illegal mining

uncertainties: 矿工最终去向尚不明确
目前仅单一来源报道，缺乏交叉验证
被驱逐人数为马里方面宣布的数字，未获独立核实
